create_CovarGMM: create a CovarGMM instance with task space boundaries, seed, and optional fitting parameters
update_CovarGMM: update the CovarGMM with a task and reward to fit Gaussian mixture models over time
sample_task_CovarGMM: sample a new task from the CovarGMM based on learning progress or random exploration
dump_CovarGMM: dump the CovarGMM bookkeeping data including weights, covariances, and means into a dictionary
proportional_choice: select an index proportionally from a value array with optional epsilon random fallback
